A [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] '''Sith Master''' eventually reigned at some point between [[Darth Cognus]] and [[Darth Gravid]]. In his tenure as the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]], he would take a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] as his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]].<ref name="Book of Sith" />
